The party hopes to leverage its past influence in the region, particularly during the 2006 Assembly elections when it supported O. Panneerselvam's campaign, to secure victory in the upcoming election.

recent_articles.title: VCK seeks parity with other allies; Thirumavalavan calls on Stalin - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
## VCK Seeks Seat Allocation Reflecting Party Strength

VCK founder and Tamil Nadu MP Thol. Thirumavalavan met with Chief Minister M.K. Stalin on Saturday to discuss seat allocation for the upcoming Assembly elections.  Thirumavalavan, accompanied by newly appointed State Information Commissioner A. Vijayaram, presented his case to Stalin, emphasizing the party's commitment to secularism and its belief that it deserves a proportionate share of seats considering its growth since 2011. VCK leaders argue that while other parties like Congress and DMDK are receiving more seats and additional Rajya Sabha representation, their own demands for "two digit" seats should be honored.  They believe the party's strength has significantly increased since 2011 when it was allotted 12 seats.
